## [Archon](https://github.com/coleam00/Archon)

A self-hosted workflow engine for running YAML-defined processes with AI agents, scripts, and approval gates. Its bundled software-development pack coordinates work from issue intake to merged pull request.

- **Kind:** Application
- **Best for:** Teams that want reviewable, repository-local workflows for AI coding tasks; Developers who need planning, validation, review, and pull-request steps to be repeatable
- **Languages:** TypeScript
- **License:** MIT

- **GitHub stars:** 23,980
